name: spatial_level2_hdf5_wrist
description: A dataset containing wrist-level spatial/contact sensor recordings (HDF5) for use in contact-aware robotics and biomechanics tasks. It is intended to evaluate models on temporal spatial prediction, contact detection, and pose/force regression for wrist-related interactions.
evaluation_method: RMSE / MAE for regression; accuracy/F1 for contact detection
reputation: A niche, research-oriented dataset on Hugging Face used by contact-aware robotics and biomechanics researchers; limited but growing adoption.
